use_case_summary: GlobalLingo runs multilingual contact centers for EU and LATAM. Primary objective: automated agent assist + end-to-end ticket summarization in 8 languages with locale-aware tone. Also need regional routing (EU vs US vs APAC), tool-calling to Zendesk/Salesforce, and graceful degradation during traffic spikes.
notes:
Account background:
- Founded 2018, spun out from translation tech team. Large customer base in EU/LatAm.
- Currently using hybrid: local translation service + Zendesk macros; slow and inconsistent for tone.

Recent timeline (bullets):
- 2026-02-18: Intro + requirements call (FF id ff_2026-02-18_GLA_kickoff). AE Avery, SE Michael. Customer: Head of CX (Isabela Mora), CTO (Luca Bianchi).
- 2026-02-24: Security questionnaire submitted. Need ISO/SOC attestation and DPA draft.
- 2026-03-03: Tech deep-dive; fed sample ticket set (50k tickets, 8 langs). Identified low-resource languages PL/RO/BG with hallucination risk.
- 2026-03-08: POC scope meeting — agreed 2-week POC, 5k eval set, rules for tone/regionalization (formal FR, relaxed BR-PT). Fireflies ff_2026-03-08_poc-review.
- 2026-03-10: Initial baseline latency test (hosted trial): p50 120ms, p95 260ms at baseline; under simulated 4x spike p95 ~520ms. Customer requires p95 <= 200ms for live agent assist.

Requirements / wants (CRM shorthand):
- Multilingual model that preserves intent + locale tone. "Customer must sound local" quote from Isabela.
- Automatic translation + rewrite: maintain politeness level, slang handling for BR-PT.
- Tool-calling: create/update Zendesk ticket, attach summary, set routing tag by language/region.
- Throughput: handle peak bursts up to 4k concurrent threads; baseline 1k concurrent.
- Latency SLO: p95 <= 200ms for agent assist responses. Ticket-summary can be async (<= 2s).
- Fallbacks: on capacity shortage must route to simpler summarizer or local translation service.
- Data residency: EU customer data must remain in EU for EU-origin tickets.
- Security: SSO (Okta SAML), enterprise KMS for key wrapping, audit logs retained 13 months.

POC details / acceptance criteria:
- 2-week POC: integrate Redwood dedicated pool in EU region, run 5k eval set across 8 languages.
- Metrics to pass: translation F1/ROUGE-ish thresholds (internal), subjective tone pass >= 85% (linguist review), hallucination rate < 1.5% on rare languages.
- Latency: baseline p95 <= 180ms; under 4x simulated spike p95 <= 300ms with graceful fallback engaged.

Open questions noted in call:
- Can Redwood provide per-region compute isolation (EU-only nodes) + proof of residency? (legal)
- SSO provisioning timeline: customer Okta team available week of 2026-03-22.
- Cost model for dedicated burst lanes during seasonal spikes.
